checkpoint: 0.3 shared human owner with independently bound agent clients/grants
tests: synthetic keys and local HTTP/ASGI only; no provider JWKS requests
claim_boundary: RS256/signature/exact issuer/audience/lifetime/scopes unchanged; signed azp only; no client_id fallback
agent_binding: immutable operator grant ID -> actor + issuer + subject + client_id + control_domain
acceptance: distinct actor, issuer/client, grant and control_domain; exact revision/hash; no operational-independence claim
compatibility: legacy nullable attribution cannot qualify; old acceptance retry receipts without matching attribution conflict; pre-existing unbound actor rejected
limitations: azp authenticates OAuth client claim, not runtime possession/independence
M1 requires separate Pip/Muse OAuth stores and calls without token sharing
configuration/grant changes require reviewed restart; old actor/grant mapping is not reassigned
